#                --spec-draft-n-max 4 -np 1
# Two requests were issued: a ~2463-token summarization prompt (no speculation)
# and a repetitive continuation prompt (ngram speculation, so a draft
# acceptance line is present).
#
# Lines are verbatim, INCLUDING the log-wrapper prefix (timestamp, level,
# process). The parser matches on substrings, so the wrapper is irrelevant to
# it -- but keeping it means these tests fail if a marker ever keys on the
# line START rather than a substring.
# 'graphs reused' is included on purpose: it is emitted by the same
# print_timings() call as the timing lines and must parse to NO events.
#
# ONLY the model path in the load_model line was generalized (from a host
# absolute path to /models/...) -- the repo forbids machine-specific values.
# Every other byte is verbatim.
